overview_description.description: Atomarine develops floating data centers for compute workloads, using standardized platforms that are built in shipyards and cooled through seawater systems. The company pairs these platforms with separate power vessels, initially using natural-gas turbines while developing marine nuclear reactors for future deployment. Its infrastructure is intended for AI operators, developers, shipbuilders, energy partners, and other organizations that require offshore compute and power capacity.
